title: Studio Data › Validations: new state_machine / format / json_schema rules save immediately with `field: created_at` and an empty message (an empty transition row persists and publishes); the conditional rule's `when` is captioned as a fail condition
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Adding a rule creates a live-looking rule against a system field with no message, before the builder has chosen anything; and the conditional rule tells the builder the opposite of what `when` means.

## Reproduction

1. Validations › Add rule › State machine (also Format, JSON schema) → the draft immediately holds `field: "created_at"`, `message: ""`; an empty transition row is stored as `"": []` and publishes.
2. Add a Conditional rule → the `when` input is captioned "Fail condition (CEL) — when true, the save is rejected", which is wrong for conditional (when = when the inner rule applies).

## Expected

A new rule is held until its field and message are set, empty rows are not stored, and the conditional caption describes `when` correctly.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` addRule defaults and the conditional caption (~608-622).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Data QA card.
- Business reason: Builders publish half-made rules by accident and misread conditional rules.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `new validation rule saved with field created_at and empty message, conditional rule when caption wrong` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 6 hits, none about Studio rule defaults or the caption (nearest closed #24512 runtime evaluation).
- QA id: U5
